behavior: A popup that is not modal and stays open has one place in the tab order, right after its trigger, while its trigger has focus guards. The Tab key goes from the element before the trigger to the trigger, to the elements of the popup, and to the element after the trigger. Shift+Tab goes the other way. A menu goes from any element of its popup to the trigger for Shift+Tab, as in Base UI. This holds when the portal is beside the trigger, before it or detached. A popup with no tabbable element is skipped in both directions. The guard before the trigger sends a focus from any other element to the trigger when the popup stays open. The guard after the trigger sends a focus from the trigger, or from no element, to the start of the popup, and a focus from another element outside the popup to the end of the popup. The portal then renders no guards of its own. A focus that comes in through the last inside guard does not stop the return of the focus, so Escape from inside the popup returns the focus to the trigger. In Base UI, Tab from the element before the trigger stays on that element. A detached portal keeps the focus at the element after the trigger, or between that element and the popup. Base UI also sets the flag that stops the return of the focus before it tests where the focus comes from, so a focus that comes in through the last inside guard stops the return of the focus at the next close.
